author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**


GO:0006281 | DNA repair | IEA with IPR038959 | GO_REF:0000002

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC29A4.08c prp19

* **Description of issue**

prp19

PTHR43995 | PANTHER | Pre-mRNA-processing factor 19 | IPR038959

is a uB ligase involved in splicing. I'm fairly confident it doesn't have a role in DNA repair (although closely related family members do) but we have a lot of interaction data which places it in multiple splicing associated complexes, but no DNA repair complexes
title: GO:0006281	 DNA repair IEA with IPR038959	GO_REF:0000002

author: blazaropinto
body:
Hi Val,
